description: a test or provisioning profile is present on the eUICC
remediation: remove test and provisioning profiles before production use (disable then delete them with `sim-doctor euicc disable` / `euicc delete`, or reset test profiles with `euicc reset --test --yes --confirm-eid <EID>`), then re-scan
reference: GSMA SGP.22 (profile classes: operational, provisioning, test); SGP.23
